# Don't grow the Global file

`M14` · Coding rule

Don't add fields to App/utils/Global.js; shared state via route params or a module store with get/set/subscribe that returns an unsubscribe (e.g. utils/bulkContactSession.js)

Defined in [[brain/context/conventions-mobile|Mobile app coding rules]].
